title: Near-daily AI use among US adults rose from 8% to 19% in six months
friendlyTitle: More US adults say they use AI almost every day
summary: Two weighted Epoch AI and Ipsos surveys found that the share of US adults reporting AI use on six or seven days of the previous week rose from 8.2% in March to 18.7% in August 2026. The samples covered 2,017 and 1,016 adults respectively, but the researchers caution that the two waves asked the frequency question differently.
friendlySummary: In two surveys, near-daily AI use rose from about 8% of US adults in March to about 19% in August. The questions were not exactly the same, so the change is an estimate rather than a perfect comparison.
whyItMatters: AI is shifting from occasional experimentation toward a daily habit for a growing group of people. Product teams and employers should plan for routine use, while avoiding false precision because the surveys used fresh samples and changed their question design between waves.
friendlyWhyItMatters: AI is becoming part of normal daily routines. Workplaces and services need practical rules, training and support for people who use it often.
